# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/projectariatools
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/projectaria_tools

## File: facebookresearch_projectariatools/projectaria_tools/core/mps/utils.py

Prompts

```
['get the nearest eye gaze data point for a given timestamp in nanoseconds', 'get the nearest closed or open loop trajectory pose for a given timestamp', 'get the nearest hand tracking result for a given timestamp in nanoseconds', 'filter a point cloud by inverse depth and depth confidence thresholds', 'project an eye gaze vector onto a camera image at a specified depth']
```

Usage

```
{'get_nearest_eye_gaze': 'get the nearest eye gaze data point for a given timestamp in nanoseconds', 'get_nearest_pose': 'get the nearest closed or open loop trajectory pose for a given timestamp', 'get_nearest_hand_tracking_result': 'get the nearest hand tracking result for a given timestamp in nanoseconds', 'filter_points_from_confidence': 'filter a point cloud by inverse depth and depth confidence thresholds', 'get_gaze_vector_reprojection': 'project an eye gaze vector onto a camera image at a specified depth'}
```
